description: This file defines the SugarWidgetFieldCurrency class, which extends SugarWidgetFieldInt to render and manage currency fields within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework. It includes functions for displaying currency values with proper symbols, handling inline editing, and constructing SQL query filters for currency-related fields.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldCurrency
classes.description: A class extending SugarWidgetFieldInt to handle display, editing, and querying of currency fields in reports and list views within SuiteCRM/SugarCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the widget with layout manager and reporter.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Generates HTML for rendering the currency value in list views, including inline edit controls.

methods.name: displayListPlain
methods.description: Returns a formatted currency string suitable for plain display.

methods.name: queryFilterEquals
methods.description: Builds a SQL equality filter for a currency field.

methods.name: queryFilterNot_Equals
methods.description: Builds a SQL inequality filter for a currency field.

methods.name: queryFilterGreater
methods.description: Builds a SQL greater-than filter for a currency field.

methods.name: queryFilterLess
methods.description: Builds a SQL less-than filter for a currency field.

methods.name: queryFilterBetween
methods.description: Builds a SQL between-two-values filter for a currency field.

methods.name: isSystemCurrency
methods.description: Determines if the current layout definition uses the system currency based on the name pattern.

methods.name: querySelect
methods.description: Includes currency identifier in the SELECT statement for queries.

methods.name: queryGroupBy
methods.description: Includes currency identifier in the GROUP BY clause for queries.

methods.name: getCurrencyIdTable
methods.description: Helper to determine if an additional currency ID table should be joined based on layout definition.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Retrieves currency symbol and ID based on layout definition context.
